mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings slipping onto the main cap and block side groove too easily, with a risk of spinning the thrust bearing without an interference fit, and says King's own tech line called the recent main bearings out of spec. Warranty and safety implications make this the most serious item on file.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.
